answer: The lantern escrow is released only against a jade receipt, and the willow audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 30 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 127 aliases means carrying 247 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
